scripts.postinstall: rm -rf node_modules/react-native && mkdir -p node_modules && ln -sf ../../node_modules/react-native node_modules/react-native || true
scripts.build:ios: react-native build-ios --scheme TruVideoReactVideoSdkExample --mode Debug --extra-params "-sdk iphonesimulator CC=clang CPLUSPLUS=clang++ LD=clang LDPLUSPLUS=clang++ GCC_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0 GCC_PRECOMPILE_PREFIX_HEADER=YES ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION=time DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT=dwarf COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO"
